reduce.description: Parallel reduce (sum) of a sequence of length n
reduce.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2

scan.description: Parallel prefix sums (scan) of a sequence of length n
scan.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2

mergesort.description: Parallel merge sort with parallel merge step. The combine cost reflects parallel overhead (fork/join/merge). Work recurrence: W(n) = 2*W(n/2) + 3n. Span recurrence: S(n) = S(n/2) + log2(n).
mergesort.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2

standard_matmul.description: Standard recursive matrix multiplication for n x n matrices. Splits into 8 subproblems of size n/2, then adds four pairs of (n/2)x(n/2) result matrices. Work recurrence: W(n) = 8*W(n/2) + 4*n^2. Span recurrence: S(n) = S(n/2) + log2(n).
standard_matmul.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2

strassen_matmul.description: Strassen's matrix multiplication for n x n matrices. Uses 7 recursive multiplications instead of 8, but requires 18 additions/subtractions of (n/2)x(n/2) matrices. Work recurrence: W(n) = 7*W(n/2) + 18*n^2. Span recurrence: S(n) = S(n/2) + log2(n).
strassen_matmul.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2

karatsuba.description: Karatsuba algorithm for multiplication of n-digit integers. Uses 3 recursive multiplications on n/2-digit numbers plus linear-cost additions. Work recurrence: W(n) = 3*W(n/2) + 4*n. Span recurrence: S(n) = S(n/2) + log2(n).
karatsuba.input_constraint: n must be a power of 2
